company.name: DeepSource
company.shortDescription: DeepSource is a unified DevSecOps platform that helps companies write secure code with static analysis and AI.
company.description: DeepSource secures your entire development lifecycle with static analysis and AI. From code quality and SAST, to open-source security, our unified DevSecOps platform provides all the tools modern software teams need to ship clean and secure code, faster. We're trusted by 6,000+ companies, from startups to Fortune 500s.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that integrates static analysis, software composition analysis, code quality checks, infrastructure as code security, and code coverage to secure and improve code throughout the development lifecycle.
productsAndServices.name: DeepSource Unified DevSecOps Platform

productsAndServices.description: Autonomous agents that monitor codebases, analyze security issues using AI reasoning, and automatically fix vulnerabilities and dependency problems by creating pull requests and commits.
productsAndServices.name: DeepSource Agents

productsAndServices.description: An AI-driven automated remediation engine that generates context-aware code fixes for detected issues and proposes them as pull requests for developer review and approval.
productsAndServices.name: Autofix™ AI

productsAndServices.description: Static analyzers developed by DeepSource that detect code quality, security, and style issues across multiple programming languages.
productsAndServices.name: Core Static Analyzers

productsAndServices.description: Third-party open-source static analyzers that run externally and report results to DeepSource, expanding language and technology support.
productsAndServices.name: Community Analyzers
